name: Harmony 650, Logitech's compile of the test setup
description: todo-compile-650 5.2.5. Logitech's own compile of the same test setup that 5.1 composed and the bench heard, written to the 650 unchanged, so the two runs can be laid side by side for what the 5.2 comparison cannot see: the pauses inside a sequence and the timing of an activity's start. The same steps as 5.1's test, with one difference in the path: Logitech puts Plasma kijken on the activity menu's first page, below Kodi kijken, where ours put it alone on the third. Predicted, as 5.1 heard it: Plasma kijken sends the Plasma's power on (seven frames, its long press version) and the KPN box's power, then the Plasma's HDMI 1 about 6.5 s after the power on, and nothing else. Radio sends KPN 1, then KPN 2 about 2 to 2.5 s later. Muziek sends Kodi's and the Sony's power, the Sony's Function three times and the Plasma's power off, and nothing to the KPN box. All Off sends Kodi's, the Sony's and the KPN box's power. The screen goes dark about 10 s after the last key. Where Logitech's run differs from 5.1's in order or in seconds, that difference is the finding. Keep the remote off the cable and pointed at the Flirc.

steps.instruction: Straight after the write the remote restarts and may show 'If any devices are still On press Help now'. Do NOT press Help. Take the remote off the cable, point it at the Flirc and press All Off once. Mark when it is quiet

Press the centre key below the screen until the screen says Activities 1/3 at the top. Expect Kodi kijken at the top and Plasma kijken below it. Press the button beside Plasma kijken (lower left). Expect 'Starting Plasma kijken', the Plasma's power on and the KPN box's power, about 6.5 s later the Plasma's HDMI 1, then a screen titled Plasma kijken with Teletext, DVR, Aspect and Radio in its corners. Mark when it settles
Touch nothing and watch the screen: note roughly how many seconds after the last press it goes dark. Then press any key once to wake it, and mark
Press the button beside Radio (lower right) once and touch nothing. Expect the KPN box's 1 and about 2 s later its 2. Mark when the 2 has been heard, or when 10 s have passed without it
Press the Listen to Music key (Muziek). Expect Kodi's and the Sony's power, the Sony's Function three times and the Plasma's power off, and nothing for the KPN box. Mark when it settles
Press All Off. Expect Kodi's, the Sony's and the KPN box's power. Mark when it is quiet
